name: crewai-research-team
title: CrewAI Research Team (researcher → analyst → reporter, fork the analyst's stance)
description: A 3-agent CrewAI-style pipeline researching 'remote work productivity'. The parent run produces a neutral report; a fork at the analyst node flips stance to 'critical', producing a measurably longer and more skeptical report. Demonstrates how Chronos lets you A/B-test agent personas without re-running the upstream researcher. Synthetic illustrative usage numbers (no real LLM calls).
